pattern: Generated cards show the whole object floating inside the frame, with even, fairly wide margins all around, often small or thin relative to the card. Real cards push the hero big and close in a three-quarter view, and often let it or its ground run off an edge (lighthouse base, desk, basketball pole, chair legs).
